issues.failure_explanation: Integrating the ODE $\dot u = M(t)u$ gives $u(t)=u_0+\int_0^t M(s)u(s)\,ds$, i.e. the kernel must be $h(t,s,u,z)=\tilde M(s,z)u$. With $h(t,s,u,z)=\tilde M(t,z)u$ as written, the Volterra equation $u(t)=u_0+\tilde M(t,z)\int_0^t u(s)ds$ is a different equation, not equivalent to problem (eq:ted) when $\tilde M$ depends on $t$; so the object whose holomorphy Lemma lem:holo yields is not (as written) the solution of the diffusion equation.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace $\tilde M(t,z)$ by $\tilde M(s,z)$ in the definition of $h$; all continuity, holomorphy and Lipschitz verifications go through verbatim since Lemma lem:holo allows dependence on both $t$ and $s$.
issues.overall_effect: Step 1 of the proof of Theorem thm:mainthm does not, as written, establish holomorphy of the actual solution map of (eq:ted) in the time-dependent case; the conclusion remains correct once the kernel is fixed.
issues.title: Volterra reformulation of the diffusion ODE uses the wrong time argument in the kernel
issues.why_classification: A one-symbol local correction restores the equivalence and every subsequent verification and conclusion survives unchanged.

issues.failure_explanation: $\tilde v(t)=\sup_{z\in\mathcal H} v(t,z)$ is a supremum of a family of differentiable functions and need not be differentiable, so the differential inequality $\tilde v'\le\beta\tilde v$ is not justified from the pointwise inequalities in $z$ (a sup of solutions of differential inequalities does not automatically satisfy the same inequality). The step also drops the factor 2 (from $2r(\tilde M)$ to $\beta$) and then reinserts it in the exponent, so the displayed chain is internally inconsistent, although the final bound (eq:bound_term) is true (in fact with a smaller exponent).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Apply Gronwall's lemma to $v(\cdot,z)$ for each fixed $z\in\mathcal H$ using $\partial_t v\le 2\beta(t)v$, obtaining $\|\tilde u(t,z)\|_2^2\le\|u_0\|_2^2\exp(2\int_0^t\beta)$, then take the supremum over $z$ and square roots.
issues.overall_effect: The derivation of the uniform bound (eq:unif_upper_bound_ext) in Step 2 has an unjustified inference; the bound itself remains valid and Corollaries cor:maincor, cor:LS, cor:CS are unaffected once the step is fixed.
issues.title: Gronwall argument differentiates a supremum over z without justification
issues.why_classification: A routine reordering of the argument (pointwise Gronwall, then sup) fixes the gap and preserves the stated bound.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: for any $f: \mathcal{U} \rightarrow \mathbb{C}$ that admits a holomorphic extension to a Bernstein polyellipse $\mathcal{E}_{\bm{\rho}} \subset \mathbb{C}^d$

issues.failure_explanation: The stated bound has right-hand side independent of $f$ (only $\rho,p,m,\epsilon$ and the noise). It cannot hold for every holomorphic $f$: replacing $f$ by $\lambda f$ (or $u_0$ by $\lambda u_0$ in cor:LS, which scales $f_v$ by $\lambda$ since (eq:ted) is linear) scales the noiseless least-squares error by $\lambda$ while the right-hand side is unchanged, so the bound fails for large $\lambda$ unless the error is identically zero. The cited result applies to functions normalized in $L^\infty(\mathcal E_\rho)$; the missing factor $\|f\|_{L^\infty(\mathcal E_\rho)}$ (bounded by $B(u_0,T,M)$ via Theorem thm:mainthm, as correctly done in cor:CS) is omitted. Corollary cor:LS inherits the same false, scale-free bound.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Insert the factor $\|f\|_{L^\infty(\mathcal E_\rho)}$ in the first term of th:main_ls and, correspondingly, $B(u_0,T,\bm M)$ (with $\mathcal H=\mathcal E_\rho$, from Theorem thm:mainthm) in cor:LS.
issues.overall_effect: Theorem th:main_ls and Corollary cor:LS are false as stated; the least-squares convergence guarantee advertised in the contributions and conclusion is only correct with the additional multiplicative factor.
issues.title: Least-squares error bound omits the necessary dependence on the size of f (norm factor)
issues.why_classification: The correction is a local insertion of a constant already available from Theorem thm:mainthm; the rate, method, and scope of the guarantee are preserved.
